entries.jp: \x48森の島
entries.en: Forest Island

entries.jp: 「え！？　こん棒を持った大きな魔物が\n
entries.en: "What?! A big monster with a club in the shallows? That's a Sea Troll!
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 浅瀬にいた？\n
それってシートロルですよ！\f
entries.speaker: 浅瀬にいた？

entries.jp: たぶん、私たちがこの島から出て来る\n
entries.en: It was probably lying in wait for us to come out from this island.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: のを待ち構えてたんだと思います。\f
あぶないところを助けられたみたいで\n
entries.en: Seems you saved us from a close call... I'll be sure to repay you someday."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: すね・・・\n
このお礼は、いつか必ずいたします」\f
entries.speaker: すね・・・

entries.jp: 「あぶないところを助けられたみたいで\n
entries.en: "Seems you saved us from a close call... I'll be sure to repay you someday."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: すね・・・\n
このお礼は、いつか必ずいたします」\f
entries.speaker: すね・・・

entries.jp: 「ここの調査が済んだら谷間の遺跡に向\n
entries.en: "Once we're done surveying here, we plan to head for the Valley Ruins. They're north of the Marshland... Eh? You know them...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: かう予定です。\n
湿原の北にあるのですが・・・\n
entries.speaker: かう予定です。

entries.jp: え？　知ってるって・・・\f
あなた、あそこで何してたんですか？\f
entries.en: What were you doing there?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ・・・なるほど、ケガの治療を。\n
entries.en: ...I see, getting your wounds treated. By a Mystic? Strange, nobody's supposed to live there.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 呪い師が？\n
変だな、あそこには誰も住んでないは\n
entries.speaker: 呪い師が？

entries.jp: ずなのに。\f
まあ、おおかた、家を失った流浪の輩\n
entries.en: Well, most likely some homeless drifters have moved in. Honestly, and it's a precious cultural heritage site! The nerve!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: が住み着いたのでしょう。\n
ったく、貴重な文化遺産だというのに、\n
entries.speaker: が住み着いたのでしょう。

entries.jp: 不届きな！」\f
「この島では、もう、収穫はなさそうで\n
entries.en: "Looks like there's nothing more to find on this island."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: す」\f
「ここにあると言われる洞窟は、昔、近\n
entries.en: "The cave said to be here is where a minor lord who ruled these parts long ago went into hiding.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 隣を治めていた小領主が隠れ住んだ場\n
所だ。\f
古文書によると疫病がはやり、隠れた\n
entries.en: According to the old texts, a plague broke out, and everyone hiding there died.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 人は全て死に絶えたらしい。\f
その時、領主は、溺愛する娘を疫病か\n
entries.en: They say that back then, the lord put his beloved daughter into eternal sleep to save her from the plague. That was several hundred years ago.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ら救う為、永遠の眠りにつかせたとい\n
う。数百年前の話だ。\f
『眠り姫が目覚める時、洞窟への入り\n
entries.en: 'When the Sleeping Princess wakes, the way into the cave opens. By the pact with the forest spirit,' it says.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 口が開く。森の精霊との契約によって』\n
とあるが？\f
古文書の通りだとすると、眠り姫は洞\n
entries.en: If the old texts are right, the Sleeping Princess is in the cave. And if it won't open unless we wake her...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 窟の中にいることになる。そいつを起\n
こさないと、洞窟が開かないっていう\n
のなら・・・\f
手が出せないよ、これ」\f
entries.en: then there's nothing we can do."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「なんにしろ、《黒竜》の遺跡とは関係\n
entries.en: "Anyway, it seems to have nothing to do with the Black Dragon ruins. Better report to the Chief."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 無いようだ。\n
主任に報告しなきゃ」\f
entries.speaker: 無いようだ。

entries.jp: カイエス\n
entries.en: Caius
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「主任？　リールとか言う１６才くらい\n
entries.en: "Chief? You mean a girl of about 16, named Riel?"
entries.speaker: カイエス
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: の少女か？」\f
「なんで知ってるの？」\f
entries.en: "How do you know that?"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: カイエス\n
entries.en: Caius
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.en: "It's nothing..."
entries.speaker: カイエス
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: （あの魔鏡の幻、どこまで真実を映して\n
entries.en: (How much truth did that Magic Mirror's vision really show me?)
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: いた？）\f
「ここのことを記した古文書なら、バル\n
entries.en: "Old texts about this place should be in the library at Balkrutha. They're under seal, though."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: クルーサの図書館にあるはずだ。封印\n
されてるけどね」\f
「あ！　そういえば、あんた、酒場\n
entries.en: "Ah! Now I remember, you were at the tavern... Please! Don't tell anyone about me!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 頼む！　私のことは黙っててくれ！」\f
entries.speaker: で・・・

entries.jp: 「ちッ、ここまで来れば何とかなると思っ\n
entries.en: "Tch, I figured I'd be fine once I made it this far, but there's no cave anywhere!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: てたのに、洞窟なんかどこにも無いじゃ\n
ないか！」\f
